spec.title: AI-Native Lean card C — Checked model contracts

status.comment: BETA projection; narrower checker scope and WISH gaps are explicit.

p.INTENT: State the property independently and require an actual checked theorem for a G1 claim.

p.APPLICABILITY: A model claims an invariant, transition law or completion condition.

p.MOTIVATION: A reader should consume an explicit, checkable operation rather than infer a claim from prose or a stale artifact.

p.STRUCTURE: Model, named theorem, strict sidecar, pinned checker and witness.

p.SCOPE: G1 checks the formal model theorem only; external observation truth and implementation correspondence remain separate premises.

p.CONSEQUENCES: Makes the declared boundary reviewable; requires explicit inputs, assumptions and checker time. No broader proof grade follows.

p.ALTERNATIVES: A bounded example can diagnose a counterexample but cannot replace the claimed general theorem.

p.RISKS: A vacuous Init or overly strong assumption can trivialize the theorem; add meaningful witnesses and review the statement. Sunset: revise or retire this card when an accepted checker/representation makes its routine obsolete.

p.EVIDENCE: No package-specific empirical result is claimed. [E-hyp]. This BETA card is grounded in the machine contract spec://org.vibevm.ai-native/lean-ai-native-lang/mechanisms/LEAN-PROOF-RUNNER#root; required runner acceptance cases are at spec://org.vibevm.ai-native/lean-ai-native-lang/mechanisms/LEAN-PROOF-RUNNER#NEGATIVE-CASES. WISH fields identify absent machinery.

band-three.title: Band 3 — Operation
band-three.fence: trigger: WHEN A model claims an invariant, transition law or completion condition. mode: inline routine: 1. State the property independently. 2. Name its assumptions and intended subject. 3. Write a non-vacuous named theorem. 4. Run the actual checker. 5. Inspect its statement and axiom set before using the witness. checker: lean-ai-native --path . check --carrier lean-proof.toml --subject <fully-qualified-subject> raid_role: layer=proof; order=after:independent-contract; batch=theorem budget: active_rules=1; first_signal=one targeted operation within its configured bound
